acip: 'DOD NA, MTHO RIS KYI BDE BA DANG , NGAN SONG GI SDUG BSNGAL MED PAR THAL, 'DOD PA DE'I PHYIR,
english: Suppose you agree that it is only a matter of better or worse misperceptions. Are you saying then that the pleasures of the higher realms don't even exist, and that the pains of the lower realms don't even exist? You must be, if you agree this way.
